items.prompt: Which checks would you report before publishing a trade-to-metadata join result?
items.modelAnswer: Check business-key uniqueness, per-trade match counts, unmatched identities, schema/NULL policy and before/after aggregate reconciliation. Define any duplicate repair and record the inputs/revision.
